**Cross-sectional structure**

- **Two distinct clusters, one macro cause.** Cluster 1 = **AI-credit** (CRWV, WULF, CORZ, CIFR, IREN, IOND, GDS, SEI, LEU, FRMI, DOCN) — the debt-financed datacenter buildout.
- Cluster 2 = **AI-optics/hardware** (AAOI, MXL, TTMI, NVTS, DELL, CIEN, LITE, COHR) — the equity side of the same trade. Hot CPI repriced the discount rate and hit both simultaneously.
- **Treat them as one position, not two.**
- **Breadth is 131:58 down.** That is a real risk-off day. Monday's 55/118 was rotation; today's is distribution.
- **The long side is 2 names, and one is a negative signal dressed as a positive one.** BSP is the entire up-side of this brief, and the marginal buyer paid *below* where the stock was trading.
- That is support, not validation.
- **FRMI is the most information-dense name here.** It rose ~20% on genuinely good news (AMD credit support) and then fell 15% into a 52-week low the next session.
- A stock that cannot hold a +20% good-news move is telling you the financing path is worse than the headline.
- **Low-conviction bucket:** KOD, XMTR, EQPT, DPC-style names at RVOL 1.4–1.6 are drift, not flow. Xometry at $5.45B and a −11.8% move on 1.5x volume is worth checking before acting.

**Needs human eyes warning**

- **SKYD's −22% is an accounting artifact and will mislead any screen.** ~471M warrants (SKYD.WS) started trading separately; NYSE cut the reference close by $0.19368.
- The stock alone is not down 22% in economic terms. Any gap-screener — **including this one** — will flag it as the day's third-worst mover. It isn't.
- Warrants strike at $12 and expire 2036; the real risks are the post-merger debt load and dilution.
- **BSP's catalyst has a bearish tell.** Berkshire bought at **$33.00 vs. a prior close of ~$38.06** — a 13% discount. Berkshire also only reached 4% ownership after a second tranche.
- That reads as a valuation-anchoring purchase. The stock is now >130x earnings and ~73x free cash flow. A discount-priced investment is not the same as an endorsement of today's $53.
- **LQDA spent its war chest.** The $380.7M settlement is ~96% of its cash ($396.1M at Sep 30) and includes **$175M due within 30 business days**.
- Q3 Yutrepia sales were $222.7M (+31% q/q), so the business is working —
- but this is a company funding operations out of a balance sheet that just paid out essentially all of it. Consolidation/dilution risk is live.
- **CRWV credit is the contagion vector.** ~15% yields on junk-rated (B+) unsecured debt, $104B backlog, and the entire neocloud complex levered the same way.
- If CoreWeave prints an IG rating the sector re-rates violently upward; if it does not, there is no floor visible in this data. Put volume was ~200k vs 106k calls.
- **This is the single highest-signal item on the board.**
- **FRMI today (Oct 15):** TensorWave lease closing was extended to **Oct 31** — that is now inside two weeks and is the next hard date.
- Plus **SMTC's analyst day is TODAY, 12:00 ET**, directly after a −7.25% day.
- **Zero live pre-market data.** The quantitative spine is ~19h old. **Do not size a 09:30 open off this artifact.**
